evals.name: eval-0-google-bing-demand
evals.prompt: find a topic to write a blog post about. topic needs to be in high demand from people searching using google and bing. topic needs to be software development related.

assertions.text: Presents a ranked shortlist of between 5 and 8 candidate topics
Scores candidates on all four axes: Demand, Gap, Fit, and Angle
Obtains real autocomplete demand data from Google and Bing, via the bundled suggest.py or equivalent direct queries
Quotes actual suggestion strings as evidence, rather than asserting demand abstractly
Names specific competing pages or authors currently ranking and states concretely what is wrong or stale about them
Applies the constraint that Filip must be able to run the topic hands-on, and says so when it drops a candidate for failing it
Includes rejected candidates with stated reasons for rejection
Distinguishes what was measured (autocomplete, what ranks, primary sources) from what was inferred (where demand goes next)
Reports Google and Bing demand separately and notes the Microsoft-stack Bing advantage
Addresses which exact phrasing to target, treating a missing suggestion tree as a titling problem rather than a dead topic
